title.zh: 卷四十二 本紀第四十二 理宗二
title.raw: 卷四十二 本紀第四十二 理宗二 Volume 42 Annals 42: Lizong 2

sentences.zh: 端平二年正月丁酉，太陰行犯太白。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Duanping, on dingyou, the Moon in motion transgressed the Great White Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Duanping, on dingyou the Moon in motion transgressed Venus.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔議胡瑗、孫明復、邵雍、歐陽修、周敦頤、司馬光、蘇軾、張載、程顥、程頤等十人從祀孔子廟庭，升孔伋十哲。

translations.literal: On jiayin, an edict deliberated on Hu Yuan, Sun Mingfu, Shao Yong, Ouyang Xiu, Zhou Dunyi, Sima Guang, Su Shi, Zhang Zai, Cheng Hao, Cheng Yi, and ten others to receive secondary sacrifice in the Confucian temple court, and elevated Kong Ji among the Ten Sages.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin an edict ordered deliberation on admitting Hu Yuan, Sun Mingfu, Shao Yong, Ouyang Xiu, Zhou Dunyi, Sima Guang, Su Shi, Zhang Zai, Cheng Hao, Cheng Yi, and nine others to secondary sacrifice in the Confucian temple, and elevated Kong Ji among the Ten Sages.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔主管侍衛馬軍孟珙黃州駐紮，措置邊防。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict ordered Supervisor of the Palace Horse Army Meng Gong to encamp at Huangzhou and arrange border defense.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict ordered Supervisor of the Palace Horse Army Meng Gong to encamp at Huangzhou and arrange border defenses.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，孟珙入見。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Meng Gong entered audience.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Meng Gong was received in audience.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以御前寧淮軍統制、借和州防禦使程芾爲大元通好使，從義郎王全副之，尋以武功郎杜顯爲添差通好副使。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Imperial Front Ninghuai Army Commander and Acting Defender of Hezhou Cheng Fei was made envoy for friendly relations with the Great Yuan; Gentleman of Following Righteousness Wang Quan accompanied him; soon Military Gentleman Du Xian was made additional vice-envoy for friendly relations.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Imperial Front Ninghuai Army Commander and Acting Defender of Hezhou Cheng Fei was appointed envoy for friendly relations with the Great Yuan, with Gentleman of Following Righteousness Wang Quan as his deputy; soon Military Gentleman Du Xian was added as vice-envoy.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子朔，日當虧不虧。

translations.literal: On the first day jiazi of the second month, the sun ought to have been eclipsed but was not.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day jiazi of the second month, a solar eclipse was due but did not occur.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，歲星守氐。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Jupiter guarded Di.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Jupiter stood in the mansion Di.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太白、填星合於胃。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Great White Star and Saturn conjoined in Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Venus and Saturn conjoined in the mansion Wei.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未，詔太學生陳均編《宋長編綱目》，進士陳文蔚著《尚書解》，並補迪功郎。

translations.literal: On yiwei of the third month, an edict ordered Imperial University student Chen Jun to compile the 《Song Long Compilation Outline》, and Presented Scholar Chen Wenwei to author the 《Explication of the Documents》—both were appointed Junior Merit Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the third month an edict ordered Imperial University student Chen Jun to compile the 《Song Long Compilation Outline》 and Presented Scholar Chen Wenwei to author the 《Explication of the Documents》; both were appointed Junior Merit Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，楊谷、楊石並升太師，尋辭免。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Yang Gu and Yang Shi were both promoted to Grand Preceptor, and soon declined the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Yang Gu and Yang Shi were both promoted to Grand Preceptor, but soon declined.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，曾從龍兼同知樞密院事，真德秀參知政事，兼給事中、兼侍讀陳卓同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On yisi, Zeng Conglong concurrently Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Zhen Dexiu Vice Commissioner of the Council; concurrently Supervising Secretary and Lecturer Chen Zhuo Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Zeng Conglong was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Zhen Dexiu Vice Commissioner of the Council, and Supervising Secretary and Lecturer Chen Zhuo Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，詔：「前四川制置鄭損，城池失守，且盜陝西五路府庫財钜萬，削官二秩，謫居溫州，簿錄其家。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiazi, an edict: "Former Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Zheng Sun, having lost his walled cities and moreover embezzled treasury wealth of the five Shaanxi circuits amounting to tens of thousands, is reduced two ranks, banished to reside at Wenzhou, and his household is to be inventoried.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiazi, an edict declared: "Former Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Zheng Sun lost his walled cities and embezzled tens of thousands from the treasuries of the five Shaanxi circuits; he is reduced two ranks, banished to Wenzhou, and his household is to be inventoried.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，都城火。

translations.literal: " On dingmao, the capital city caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingmao fire broke out in the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Great White Star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大閱。

translations.literal: On wuzi, a grand review.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the court held a grand military review.

sentences.zh: 有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: There was a meteor as large as the Great White Star.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor appeared as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，雨雹。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yiwei, rain and hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yiwei, rain and hail fell.

sentences.zh: 軍民交哄，御前諸軍都統制趙勝削三秩，罷，命韓昱代之。

translations.literal: Soldiers and civilians clashed in uproar; Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Front Armies Zhao Sheng was reduced three ranks and dismissed; Han Yu was ordered to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians clashed; Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Front Armies Zhao Sheng was reduced three ranks and dismissed, and Han Yu was appointed in his place.

sentences.zh: 丙申，大雨、雹。

translations.literal: On bingshen, heavy rain and hail.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen heavy rain and hail fell.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，真德秀薨，贈銀青光祿大夫，諡文忠。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Zhen Dexiu died; posthumously granted Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Glorious Blessing; posthumous name Wenzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhen Dexiu died; he was posthumously granted Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Glorious Blessing and the posthumous name Wenzhong.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以喬行簡兼參知政事。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Qiao Xingjian was made concurrent Vice Commissioner of the Council.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Qiao Xingjian was appointed concurrent Vice Commissioner of the Council.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，太陰入氐。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renshen, the Moon entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renshen, the Moon entered the mansion Di.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以鄭清之爲特進、左丞相兼樞密使，喬行簡金紫光祿大夫、右丞相兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Zheng Qingzhi was made Special Advancement and Left Chief Councillor concurrently Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Qiao Xingjian Golden-Gleam Grand Master of Glorious Blessing, Right Chief Councillor concurrently Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Zheng Qingzhi was appointed Special Advancement and Left Chief Councillor concurrently Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Qiao Xingjian Golden-Gleam Grand Master of Glorious Blessing, Right Chief Councillor concurrently Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己卯，葛洪資政殿大學士，予祠祿。

translations.literal: On jimao, Ge Hong was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and granted a stipend for temple service.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Ge Hong was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and granted a stipend for temple service.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: On gengchen, a meteor fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen a meteor fell in daylight.

sentences.zh: 祈雨。

translations.literal: Prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: The court offered prayers for rain.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以曾從龍知樞密院事兼參知政事，崔與之參知政事，鄭性之同知樞密院事，陳卓簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On renwu, Zeng Conglong was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Council; Cui Yuzhi Vice Commissioner of the Council; Zheng Xingzhi Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Chen Zhuo Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Zeng Conglong was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Council, Cui Yuzhi Vice Commissioner of the Council, Zheng Xingzhi Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Chen Zhuo Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 賜進士吳叔告以下四百五十四人及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Presented Scholars Wu Shugao and 454 others below were granted passage and entry with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: Presented Scholars Wu Shugao and 454 others were granted degrees and entry with distinctions.

sentences.zh: 己丑，熒惑入太微垣。

translations.literal: On jichou, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔鄭損更削兩秩，竄南劍州。

translations.literal: On gengyin, an edict further reduced Zheng Sun two ranks and banished him to Nanjian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin an edict further reduced Zheng Sun two ranks and banished him to Nanjian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingyou, there was a meteor as large as the Great White Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingyou, a meteor appeared as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太白經天。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the Great White Star crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Venus crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: On xinchou, a meteor fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou a meteor fell in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太白入東井。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Great White Star entered the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Venus entered the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 庚申，禮部尚書魏了翁上十事，不報。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Minister of Rites Wei Liaoweng submitted ten matters; no response.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Minister of Rites Wei Liaoweng submitted ten policy proposals; the court gave no response.

sentences.zh: 閏七月戊寅，詔錄開禧蜀難死事之臣，大安知軍楊震仲孫忠孫補下州文學；

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month, on wuyin, an edict recorded ministers who died in the Kaixi Shu disaster: Military Commissioner of Da'an Yang Zhenzhong's grandson Zhongsun was appointed Lower-Prefecture Literary Officer;
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month, on wuyin, an edict recorded ministers who died in the Kaixi Shu disaster: Military Commissioner of Da'an Yang Zhenzhong's grandson Zhongsun was appointed Lower-Prefecture Literary Officer;

sentences.zh: 利州路常平幹官劉當可母王氏義不降曦，投江而死，追贈和義郡夫人，當可與升官差除。

translations.literal: Lizhou Circuit Ever-Normal clerk Liu Dangke's mother Lady Wang, righteous and refusing to submit to Xi, threw herself into the river and died; posthumously enfeoffed as Lady of the Commandery of Heyi; Dangke was granted promotion and appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Lizhou Circuit Ever-Normal clerk Liu Dangke's mother Lady Wang, refusing to submit to Wu Xi, drowned herself in the river; she was posthumously enfeoffed as Lady of the Commandery of Heyi, and Dangke was granted promotion and appointment.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賜少師、特進、銀青光祿大夫趙方諡忠肅。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the late Junior Preceptor, Special Advancement, and Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Glorious Blessing Zhao Fang was granted the posthumous name Zhongsu.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the late Junior Preceptor, Special Advancement, and Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Glorious Blessing Zhao Fang was granted the posthumous name Zhongsu.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，故保寧軍節度使、魯國公安丙諡忠定。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the late Military Commissioner of Baoning Army and Duke of Lu An Bing was granted the posthumous name Zhongding.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the late Military Commissioner of Baoning Army and Duke of Lu An Bing was granted the posthumous name Zhongding.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，全子才、劉子澄坐唐州之役棄兵宵遁，子才削二秩，謫居衡州，子澄削二秩，謫居瑞州。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Quan Zicai and Liu Zicheng, on account of the Tangzhou campaign abandoning troops and fleeing by night—Zicai reduced two ranks and banished to Hengzhou; Zicheng reduced two ranks and banished to Ruizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Quan Zicai and Liu Zicheng, for abandoning their troops and fleeing by night during the Tangzhou campaign, were each reduced two ranks—Zicai banished to Hengzhou and Zicheng to Ruizhou.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，歲星入氐。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guisi, Jupiter entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guisi, Jupiter entered the mansion Di.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以太師趙汝愚配享寧宗廟庭，仍圖像於昭勳崇德之閣。

translations.literal: On yimao, Grand Preceptor Zhao Ruyu was granted secondary sacrifice in Ningzong's temple court, and his portrait was still placed in the Pavilion of Illustrious Merit and Exalted Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Grand Preceptor Zhao Ruyu was granted secondary sacrifice in Ningzong's temple court, and his portrait was placed in the Pavilion of Illustrious Merit and Exalted Virtue.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太白犯太微垣右執法。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the Great White Star transgressed the Right Law-Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Venus transgressed the Right Law-Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，崇國公主薨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guiwei, Princess of Chongguo died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiwei, the Princess of Chongguo died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinmao, there was a meteor as large as the Great White Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinmao, a meteor appeared as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 己未，填星犯畢，歲星、太白合於心。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Saturn transgressed Bi; Jupiter and the Great White Star conjoined in Xin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Saturn transgressed Bi, and Jupiter and Venus conjoined in the mansion Xin.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，以曾從龍爲樞密使、督視江淮軍馬，魏了翁同簽書樞密院事、督視京湖軍馬，鄭性之兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yichou, Zeng Conglong was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Supervisor of Jiang-Huai forces; Wei Liaoweng Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Supervisor of Jing-Hu forces; Zheng Xingzhi acting Vice Commissioner of the Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yichou, Zeng Conglong was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Supervisor of Jiang-Huai forces, Wei Liaoweng Associate Signatory and Supervisor of Jing-Hu forces, and Zheng Xingzhi acting Vice Commissioner of the Council.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔兩督府各給金千兩、銀五萬兩、度牒千、緡錢五百萬爲隨軍資。

translations.literal: On wuchen, an edict granted each of the two supervisory offices one thousand taels of gold, fifty thousand taels of silver, one thousand ordination certificates, and five million strings of cash as campaign funds.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen an edict granted each supervisory office one thousand taels of gold, fifty thousand taels of silver, one thousand ordination certificates, and five million strings of cash as campaign funds.

sentences.zh: 台臣李鳴復論曾從龍、魏了翁督府事，不允。

translations.literal: Censor Li Mingfu remonstrated against Zeng Conglong and Wei Liaoweng's supervisory offices; not approved.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Li Mingfu remonstrated against the supervisory appointments of Zeng Conglong and Wei Liaoweng; the court did not approve his objection.

sentences.zh: 戊子，安南國貢方物。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Annam presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Annam presented tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，曾從龍六疏乞寢樞密使命，依舊知樞密院事、督視江淮軍馬。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengyin, Zeng Conglong six times memorialized begging to suspend the Bureau of Military Affairs commission, retaining his former post as Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Supervisor of Jiang-Huai forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengyin, Zeng Conglong six times memorialized asking to be relieved of the Bureau of Military Affairs commission while retaining his post as Director and Supervisor of Jiang-Huai forces.

sentences.zh: 詔許辭樞密使。

translations.literal: An edict permitted him to resign as Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict permitted him to resign as Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 以魏了翁兼督視江淮軍馬。

translations.literal: Wei Liaoweng was made concurrently Supervisor of Jiang-Huai forces.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Liaoweng was made concurrently Supervisor of Jiang-Huai forces.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，四川制置司遣將斬叛軍首賊蒲世興于萬州。

translations.literal: On guisi, the Sichuan Pacification Office dispatched a general who beheaded the rebel chieftain Pu Shixing at Wanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Sichuan Pacification Office dispatched a general who beheaded the rebel chieftain Pu Shixing at Wanzhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，填星守天街星。

translations.literal: On jihai, Saturn guarded the Heavenly Street Star.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Saturn stood at the Heavenly Street Star.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔官告院制修武郎以下告身給督視府。

translations.literal: On gengzi, an edict ordered the Bureau of Official Commissions to prepare commission documents for Military Gentlemen and below to be given to the supervisory offices.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi an edict ordered the Bureau of Official Commissions to prepare commission documents for ranks from Military Gentleman downward for the supervisory offices.

sentences.zh: 太陰入井。

translations.literal: The Moon entered the Well.
translations.idiomatic: The Moon entered the Well.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，魏了翁陛辭，詔事幹機速，許便宜行之。

translations.literal: On renyin, Wei Liaoweng took leave at court; an edict ordered him to handle urgent matters and permitted discretionary action.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Wei Liaoweng took leave at court; an edict ordered him to handle urgent matters and permitted discretionary action.

sentences.zh: 吳潛樞密都承旨、督府參謀官，趙善瀚、馬光祖督府參議官。

translations.literal: Wu Qian was Bureau Chief Secretary and supervisory staff officer; Zhao Shanhui and Ma Guangzu supervisory deliberative officers.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Qian was appointed Bureau Chief Secretary and supervisory staff officer; Zhao Shanhui and Ma Guangzu were made supervisory deliberative officers.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，曾從龍薨，贈少師。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Zeng Conglong died; posthumously granted Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zeng Conglong died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 餘嶸同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Yu Yan was made Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yan was made Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，故參知政事李壁諡文懿。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the late Vice Commissioner of the Council Li Bi was granted the posthumous name Wenyi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the late Vice Commissioner of the Council Li Bi was granted the posthumous name Wenyi.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，雷。

translations.literal: On xinhai, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai thunder sounded.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己未朔，以星行失度，雷發非時，罷天基節宴。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the first day jiwei, because the stars moved out of measure and thunder came untimely, the Tianji Festival banquet was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the first day jiwei, because the stars moved out of measure and thunder came out of season, the Tianji Festival banquet was canceled.

sentences.zh: 詔勸農桑。

translations.literal: An edict exhorted agriculture and sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict exhorted the people to tend agriculture and sericulture.

sentences.zh: 賜安南國王封爵、襲衣、金帶。

translations.literal: The king of Annam was granted enfeoffment rank, ceremonial robe, and gold belt.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Annam was granted enfeoffment rank, a ceremonial robe, and a gold belt.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，填星犯畢。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Saturn transgressed Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Saturn transgressed Bi.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大元兵連攻洪山，張順、翁大成等以兵捍禦之。

translations.literal: On renshen, Great Yuan troops continuously attacked Hongshan; Zhang Shun, Weng Dacheng, and others led troops to defend against them.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Great Yuan troops continuously attacked Hongshan; Zhang Shun, Weng Dacheng, and others led troops in defense.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，詔以大元兵攻江陵，統制李復明奮勇戰沒，其贈三秩，仍官其二子。

translations.literal: On jiawu of the second month, an edict: because Great Yuan troops attacked Jiangling, Commander Li Fuming fought bravely and died—posthumously grant three ranks and still appoint his two sons to office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu of the second month an edict declared that when Great Yuan troops attacked Jiangling, Commander Li Fuming fought bravely and died; he was posthumously granted three ranks and his two sons were appointed to office.

sentences.zh: 死傷士卒，趣具姓名來上。

translations.literal: For dead and wounded soldiers, hasten to compile names and submit them.
translations.idiomatic: For dead and wounded soldiers, officials were ordered to compile names and submit them promptly.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔侍從、台諫、給舍條具邊防事宜。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict ordered attendants, censors, remonstrators, and supervising secretaries to itemize border-defense matters.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict ordered attendants, censors, remonstrators, and supervising secretaries to itemize border-defense matters.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，起居郎吳泳上疏論淮、蜀、京、襄捍禦十事，不報。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Attendant Gentleman Wu Yong submitted a memorial discussing ten matters of defense for Huai, Shu, Jing, and Xiang; no response.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Attendant Gentleman Wu Yong submitted a memorial discussing ten matters of defense for Huai, Shu, Jing, and Xiang; the court gave no response.

sentences.zh: 詔魏了翁依舊端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事，其速赴闕。

translations.literal: An edict restored Wei Liaoweng to his former post as Academician of the Hall of Illuminated Sagacity and Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; he was to hasten to court.
translations.idiomatic: An edict restored Wei Liaoweng to Academician of the Hall of Illuminated Sagacity and Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs and ordered him to hasten to court.

sentences.zh: 詔史嵩之淮西制置使兼副使。

translations.literal: An edict made Shi Songzhi Huaidong Pacification Commissioner concurrently Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Shi Songzhi Huaidong Pacification Commissioner concurrently Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，日暈周匝。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the sun was haloed all around.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai a complete solar halo appeared.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，左曹郎官趙以夫上備邊十策。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Left Bureau Gentleman Zhao Yifu submitted ten strategies for border preparedness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Left Bureau Gentleman Zhao Yifu submitted ten strategies for border preparedness.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，吳潛赴闕。

translations.literal: On yihai of the third month, Wu Qian proceeded to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the third month Wu Qian proceeded to court.

sentences.zh: 是月，襄陽北軍主將王旻、李伯淵焚城郭倉庫，相繼降北。

translations.literal: That month, the northern-army commanders of Xiangyang Wang Min and Li Boyuan burned the city walls and storehouses and successively surrendered to the north.
translations.idiomatic: That month the northern-army commanders of Xiangyang Wang Min and Li Boyuan burned the city walls and storehouses and successively surrendered to the north.

sentences.zh: 時城中官民兵四萬七千有奇，其財粟三十萬、軍器二十四庫皆亡，金銀鹽鈔不與焉。

translations.literal: At the time the city held more than forty-seven thousand government troops and militia; its grain stores of three hundred thousand, twenty-four armories of weapons—all were lost, not counting gold, silver, salt certificates, and paper money.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the city held more than forty-seven thousand government troops and militia; grain stores of three hundred thousand and twenty-four armories of weapons were all lost, not counting gold, silver, salt certificates, and paper money.

sentences.zh: 南軍主將李虎乘火縱掠，襄陽爲空。

translations.literal: The southern-army commander Li Hu took advantage of the fire to plunder wantonly; Xiangyang was emptied.
translations.idiomatic: Southern-army commander Li Hu took advantage of the fire to plunder wantonly, and Xiangyang was left empty.

sentences.zh: 制置使趙範坐失撫禦，致南北軍交爭造亂，詔削官三秩，落龍圖閣學士，姑仍制置職任。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Zhao Fan, on account of failure to pacify and control, causing northern and southern armies to clash and create disorder—an edict reduced him three ranks, stripped Dragon Diagram Hall Academician, but for the time being retained his pacification duties.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Zhao Fan, for failing to pacify the armies and causing northern and southern forces to clash in disorder, was reduced three ranks and stripped of Dragon Diagram Hall Academician, but for the time being retained his pacification post.

sentences.zh: 階、岷、疊、宕十八族降。

translations.literal: The eighteen tribes of Jie, Min, Die, and Dang submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The eighteen tribes of Jie, Min, Die, and Dang submitted.

sentences.zh: 有諜者以檄招曹友聞軍降，友聞斬之以聞。

translations.literal: A spy used a proclamation to summon Cao Youwen's army to surrender; Youwen beheaded him and reported it.
translations.idiomatic: A spy used a proclamation to summon Cao Youwen's army to surrender; Youwen beheaded him and reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，太陰入太微垣。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on bingshen, the Moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingshen, the Moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 己酉，魏了翁乞歸田里，詔不允，以資政殿學士知潭州。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Wei Liaoweng begged to return to his home district; an edict did not approve, and he was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and prefect of Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Wei Liaoweng begged to return home; the court did not approve and made him Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and prefect of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔悔開邊，責己，其京湖、興、沔州軍縣鎮見系囚情理輕者釋之。

translations.literal: On guichou, an edict repented opening the border, blamed itself, and for Jing-Hu, Xing, and Mian prefectures, circuits, counties, and garrisons—among prisoners currently held, those whose cases were light in circumstance were released.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict repented opening hostilities on the border, blamed itself, and ordered the release of lightly sentenced prisoners held in Jing-Hu, Xing, and Mian circuits.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，提舉萬壽觀洪咨夔依舊兼侍讀。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wuyin, Hong Zixie, Commissioner of the Longevity Abbey, was restored to his former concurrent post as Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuyin, Hong Zixie, Commissioner of the Longevity Abbey, was restored to his former concurrent post as Lecturer.

sentences.zh: 己卯，有流星出心，大如太白。

translations.literal: On jimao, a meteor came forth from Xin, as large as the Great White Star.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao a meteor issued from the mansion Xin, as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太陰入畢。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the Moon entered Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the Moon entered Bi.

sentences.zh: 甲申，趙葵華文閣直學士、淮東安撫制置使兼知揚州。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Zhao Kui was made Direct Academician of the Huawen Hall, Huaidong Pacification and Pacification Commissioner, and concurrently prefect of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhao Kui was made Direct Academician of the Huawen Hall, Huaidong Pacification and Pacification Commissioner, and concurrently prefect of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，流星夕隕。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dinghai, a meteor fell at evening.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dinghai, a meteor fell in the evening.

sentences.zh: 己亥，洪咨夔卒，詔與執政恩例，贈二秩，諡忠文。

translations.literal: On jihai, Hong Zixie died; an edict granted him the favor shown chief ministers, posthumously two ranks, posthumous name Zhongwen.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Hong Zixie died; an edict granted him the favor shown chief ministers, two posthumous ranks, and the name Zhongwen.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，熒惑、填星合于畢。

translations.literal: On guimao, Mars and Saturn conjoined in Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Mars and Saturn conjoined in Bi.

sentences.zh: 丙午，熒惑犯填星。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Mars transgressed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Mars transgressed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大雨、雹。

translations.literal: On gengxu, heavy rain and hail.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu heavy rain and hail fell.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，祈睛。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingsi, prayers for clear weather were offered.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingsi, the court offered prayers for clear weather.

sentences.zh: 詔權徐州國安用力戰役而歿，已贈順昌軍節度使，仍官其子國興承節郎。

translations.literal: An edict: Acting Xuzhou Guo An, having exerted himself in battle and died, had already been posthumously granted Military Commissioner of Shunchang Army; his son Guo Xing was still appointed Bearer of Following Integrity Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that Guo An of Xuzhou, having fought strenuously and died, had already been posthumously granted Military Commissioner of Shunchang Army; his son Guo Xing was appointed Bearer of Following Integrity Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以趙範失襄城，罪重罰輕，詔罷職奉祠。

translations.literal: On gengshen, because Zhao Fan lost Xiangcheng—the crime heavy, the punishment light—an edict dismissed him from office and granted temple service.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, because Zhao Fan lost Xiangcheng—the crime heavy yet the punishment light—an edict dismissed him from office and granted temple service.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太陰入氐。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Moon entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the Moon entered the mansion Di.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以鄭性之參知政事，李嗚復簽書樞密院事，戊辰，監察御史杜范、吳昌裔以言事不報，上疏乞罷官，詔改授范太常少卿，昌裔太常卿。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Zheng Xingzhi was made Vice Commissioner of the Council; Li Mingfu Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs. On wuchen, Investigating Censor Du Fan and Wu Changyi, because their remonstrances went unanswered, submitted memorials begging to resign office; an edict reassigned Fan as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Changyi as Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Zheng Xingzhi was made Vice Commissioner of the Council and Li Mingfu Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs. On wuchen Investigating Censors Du Fan and Wu Changyi, because their remonstrances went unanswered, submitted memorials begging to resign; an edict reassigned Fan as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Changyi as Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 庚午，熒惑入井。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Mars entered the Well.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Mars entered the Well.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太陰入東井。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Moon entered the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the Moon entered the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 甲申，雨血。

translations.literal: On jiashen, blood rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen blood rain fell.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，詔趙範更削兩秩、謫居建寧府，李虎削三秩、落刺史，罷御器械，各令任責捍禦自效。

translations.literal: On bingxu, an edict further reduced Zhao Fan two ranks and banished him to Jianning Prefecture; Li Hu was reduced three ranks, stripped of prefect, dismissed from Imperial Armory duties—each was ordered to take responsibility for defense and prove himself.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu an edict further reduced Zhao Fan two ranks and banished him to Jianning Prefecture; Li Hu was reduced three ranks, stripped of his prefectural post, and dismissed from Imperial Armory duties—each was ordered to take responsibility for defense and prove himself.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔前龍圖閣學士、光祿大夫、贈開府儀同三司傅伯成諡忠簡。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict granted the late Dragon Diagram Hall Academician, Grand Master of Glorious Blessing, posthumously Grand Mentor of the State Fu Bocheng the posthumous name Zhongjian.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao an edict granted the late Dragon Diagram Hall Academician, Grand Master of Glorious Blessing, posthumously Grand Mentor of the State Fu Bocheng the posthumous name Zhongjian.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，太白、歲星合於尾。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengshen, the Great White Star and Jupiter conjoined in Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengshen, Venus and Jupiter conjoined in the mansion Wei.

sentences.zh: 庚午，雷。

translations.literal: On gengwu, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 辛未，祀明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinwei, sacrificed at the Bright Hall; a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Bright Hall was sacrificed to and a general amnesty was granted.

sentences.zh: 雷雨。

translations.literal: Thunder and rain.
translations.idiomatic: There was thunder and rain.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，左丞相兼樞密使鄭清之罷爲觀文殿大學士、醴泉觀使兼侍讀，右丞相兼樞密使喬行簡罷爲觀文殿大學士、醴泉觀使兼侍讀。

translations.literal: On yihai, Left Chief Councillor concurrently Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zheng Qingzhi was dismissed and made Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, Commissioner of the Liquor Spring Abbey concurrently Lecturer; Right Chief Councillor concurrently Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Qiao Xingjian was dismissed and made Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, Commissioner of the Liquor Spring Abbey concurrently Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Left Chief Councillor and Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zheng Qingzhi was dismissed and made Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, Commissioner of the Liquor Spring Abbey, and Lecturer; Right Chief Councillor and Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Qiao Xingjian was dismissed to the same posts.

sentences.zh: 以崔與之爲右丞相兼樞密使。

translations.literal: Cui Yuzhi was appointed Right Chief Councillor concurrently Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yuzhi was appointed Right Chief Councillor concurrently Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬午，驍衛大將軍、利州駐紮御前諸軍統制曹友聞與大元兵大戰于大安軍陽平關，兵敗，死之。

translations.literal: On renwu, Brave Guard General and Commander of Imperial Front Armies encamped at Lizhou Cao Youwen fought a great battle with Great Yuan troops at Yangping Pass in Da'an Army; his forces were defeated and he died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Cao Youwen, Brave Guard General and commander of Imperial Front Armies encamped at Lizhou, fought a great battle with Great Yuan forces at Yangping Pass in Da'an Army; his army was defeated and he was killed.

sentences.zh: 詔贈龍圖閣學士、大中大夫，諡毅節，立廟曰褒忠，官其二子承務郎。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously granted him Academician of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion and Grand Master of Palace Attendance; posthumous name Yijie; a temple was erected called Baozhong; his two sons were appointed Attendant Gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously granted him Academician of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion and Grand Master of Palace Attendance, with the posthumous name Yijie; a temple called Baozhong was erected, and his two sons were appointed Attendant Gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，詔：「殿前司將胡斌，曩死邵武之寇，贈武節大夫，有司爲立後授官，因舊廟賜額。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on yiyou, an edict declared: "Palace Front Division General Hu Bin, who died earlier in the Shaowu bandit raid, is posthumously granted Grand Master of Martial Integrity; the responsible offices are to establish a successor and grant office; his former temple is granted an inscribed plaque.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yiyou, an edict declared: "Palace Front Division General Hu Bin, who had died earlier in the Shaowu raid, is posthumously granted Grand Master of Martial Integrity; the responsible offices are to establish a successor and grant office, and his former temple is granted an inscribed plaque.

sentences.zh: 宗室師礻賈死尤溪之戰，贈武節郎，官其一子進義校尉，立廟林嶺。

translations.literal: Imperial clansman Shi Ben, who died in the battle at Youxi, is posthumously granted Gentleman of Martial Integrity; one son is appointed Captain of Advancing Righteousness; a temple is erected at Linling.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansman Shi Ben, who died in the battle at Youxi, is posthumously granted Gentleman of Martial Integrity; one son is appointed Captain of Advancing Righteousness, and a temple is erected at Linling.

sentences.zh: 」甲午，詔：「沿江制置使陳韡應援淮東，授淮西制置使兼沿江制置副使史嵩之應援江陵、峽州江面上流。

translations.literal: " On jiawu, an edict declared: "Yangzi River Defense Commissioner Chen Wei is to support Huai East; Huai West Pacification Commissioner concurrently Yangzi River Defense Deputy Commissioner Shi Songzhi is to support the upper reaches of the river surface at Jiangling and Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiawu an edict declared: "Yangzi River Defense Commissioner Chen Wei is to reinforce Huai East; Huai West Pacification Commissioner and Yangzi River Defense Deputy Commissioner Shi Songzhi is to reinforce the upper river at Jiangling and Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 」壬寅，大元兵破固始縣，淮西將呂文信、杜林率潰兵數萬叛，六安、霍丘皆爲群盜所據。

translations.literal: " On renyin, Great Yuan troops captured Gushi County; Huai West generals Lu Wenxin and Du Lin led tens of thousands of routed troops in revolt; Lu'an and Huoqiu were both seized by bandit gangs.
translations.idiomatic: " On renyin Great Yuan forces captured Gushi County; Huai West generals Lu Wenxin and Du Lin led tens of thousands of routed troops in rebellion, and Lu'an and Huoqiu were both seized by bandits.

sentences.zh: 丙午，安南國貢方物，詔授金紫光祿大夫、靜海軍節度、觀察等使，賜襲衣、金銀帶。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Annam presented tribute goods; an edict appointed him Golden-Gleam Grand Master of Glorious Blessing, Military Commissioner of Jinghai Army, and Commissioner of Observation and other offices; court robes and gold and silver belts were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Annam presented tribute; an edict granted its ruler Golden-Gleam Grand Master of Glorious Blessing, Military Commissioner of Jinghai Army, and Commissioner of Observation and other offices, and bestowed court robes and gold and silver belts.

sentences.zh: 大元太子闊端兵離成都，大元兵破文州，守臣劉銳、通判趙汝曏死之。

translations.literal: Great Yuan Crown Prince Kuoduan's army departed Chengdu; Great Yuan troops captured Wen Prefecture; defending official Liu Rui and Vice Prefect Zhao Ruxiang died.
translations.idiomatic: The army of Great Yuan Crown Prince Kuoduan left Chengdu; Great Yuan forces captured Wen Prefecture, and defending official Liu Rui and Vice Prefect Zhao Ruxiang were killed.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，詔嗣秀王師彌授少師。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuwu, an edict granted Prince Xiuxi Shi Mi the title of Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuwu, an edict granted Prince Xiuxi Shi Mi the title of Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以喬行簡爲特進、左丞相兼樞密使，封肅國公。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Qiao Xingjian was appointed Special Advancement and Left Chief Councillor concurrently Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, enfeoffed as Duke of Suyu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Qiao Xingjian was appointed Special Advancement and Left Chief Councillor concurrently Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and enfeoffed as Duke of Suyu.

sentences.zh: 大元兵圍光州，詔史嵩之援光，趙葵援合肥，陳韡遏和州，爲淮西聲援。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops besieged Guang Prefecture; an edict ordered Shi Songzhi to relieve Guang, Zhao Kui to relieve Hefei, Chen Wei to block He Prefecture, as strategic support for Huai West.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces besieged Guang Prefecture; an edict ordered Shi Songzhi to relieve Guang, Zhao Kui to relieve Hefei, and Chen Wei to block He Prefecture as strategic support for Huai West.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，魏了翁依舊資政殿學士、知紹興府、浙東安撫使，吳潛、袁甫、徐清叟赴闕。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Wei Liaoweng was restored to Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, prefect of Shaoxing, and Zhedong Pacification Commissioner; Wu Qian, Yuan Fu, and Xu Qingsou proceeded to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Wei Liaoweng was restored as Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, prefect of Shaoxing, and Zhedong Pacification Commissioner; Wu Qian, Yuan Fu, and Xu Qingsou came to court.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔侍從、兩省、台諫、卿監、宰掾、樞屬、郎官、鈐轄，各陳防邊方略。

translations.literal: On renshen, an edict ordered attendants-in-waiting, the two provincial offices, censorate and remonstrance officials, directorate officials, chief-minister staffs, bureau of military affairs staff, bureau of review officials, and controllers each to submit border-defense plans.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen an edict ordered attendants-in-waiting, officials of the two provincial offices, the censorate and remonstrance, directorate and chief-minister staffs, bureau of military affairs staff, bureau of review officials, and controllers each to submit plans for border defense.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太陰入太微垣。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the Moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，復成都府。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Chengdu Prefecture was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Chengdu Prefecture was recovered.

sentences.zh: 十二月戎戌，以吳淵戶部侍郎、淮東總領財賦兼知鎮江府。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuxu, Wu Yuan was made Vice Minister of Revenue, overall fiscal administrator of Huai East, and concurrently prefect of Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuxu, Wu Yuan was made Vice Minister of Revenue, overall fiscal administrator of Huai East, and concurrently prefect of Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔改明年爲嘉熙元年。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict changed the next year to the first year of Jiaxi.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict changed the next year to the first year of Jiaxi.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，鄭清之辭免觀文殿大學士、醴泉觀使兼侍讀，詔仍舊觀文殿大學士、提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: On guimao, Zheng Qingzhi declined Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, Commissioner of the Liquor Spring Abbey concurrently Lecturer; an edict retained him as Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and Commissioner for Overseeing the Grotto Heaven of Mount Tong.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Zheng Qingzhi declined the posts of Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, Commissioner of the Liquor Spring Abbey, and Lecturer; an edict retained him as Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and Commissioner for Overseeing the Grotto Heaven of Mount Tong.

sentences.zh: 丁未，宣繒薨，以定策功，贈太師，諡忠靖。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Xuan Zi died; for his merit in settling the succession, he was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and posthumous name Zhongjing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Xuan Zi died; for his merit in settling the succession he was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and the posthumous name Zhongjing.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，池州都統趙邦永以援滁州功，詔邦永轉左武大夫，其餘立功將士具等第、姓名推賞。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Chizhou Commander-in-Chief Zhao Bangyong for his merit in relieving Chuzhou, an edict promoted Bangyong to Left Martial Grand Master; the remaining meritorious officers and soldiers were to have grades and names submitted for rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, for his merit in relieving Chuzhou, Chizhou Commander-in-Chief Zhao Bangyong was promoted by edict to Left Martial Grand Master; the remaining meritorious officers and soldiers were to have grades and names submitted for rewards.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙元年春正月乙卯，以魏了翁知福州兼福建安撫使。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring, the first year of Jiaxi, on yimao, Wei Liaoweng was made prefect of Fuzhou concurrently Fujian Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the first year of Jiaxi, on yimao, Wei Liaoweng was made prefect of Fuzhou concurrently Fujian Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔京西兵馬都監、隨州駐紮程再暹官三轉，帶行閣門宣贊舍人、京西鈐轄兼知隨州，賞其洪山戰功，餘有功將士趣以名上。

translations.literal: On dingsi, an edict granted Jingxi Military Supervisor and commander encamped at Suizhou Cheng Zaixian three rank promotions, with acting Senior Palace Gate Emissary and Attendant, Jingxi Controller concurrently prefect of Suizhou, in reward for his merit at the battle of Hongshan; remaining meritorious officers and soldiers were to have names submitted promptly.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi an edict granted Cheng Zaixian, Jingxi Military Supervisor encamped at Suizhou, three rank promotions, with acting Senior Palace Gate Emissary and Attendant, Jingxi Controller, and concurrent prefect of Suizhou, in reward for his merit at Hongshan; remaining meritorious officers and soldiers were to have names submitted promptly.

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi there was thunder.
