translations.literal: On renzi, Li Xinchuan was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Historiographic Compiler to compile Veritable Records of the reigns of Gaozong, Xiaozong, Guangzong, and Ningzong.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Li Xinchuan was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Historiographic Compiler to compile Veritable Records of the reigns of Gaozong, Xiaozong, Guangzong, and Ningzong.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以高定子爲中書舍人、京湖江西督視參贊軍事。

translations.literal: On guichou, Gao Dingzi was made Drafting Secretary and Jinghu-Jiangxi Overseer's staff consulting military officer.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Gao Dingzi was made Drafting Secretary and Jinghu-Jiangxi Overseer's staff consulting military officer.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔史嵩之兼督視光、蘄、黃、夔、施州軍馬。

translations.literal: On gengshen, an edict made Shi Songzhi additionally oversee military forces of Guang, Qi, Huang, Kui, and Shi prefectures and armies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen an edict made Shi Songzhi additionally oversee military forces of Guang, Qi, Huang, Kui, and Shi prefectures and armies.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，發行都會子二百萬、並湖廣九百萬，下都督參政行府犒師。

translations.literal: On wuchen, two million metropolitan notes and nine million combined for Lake-Guang were issued to the Chief Administrator-Commissioner-in-Chief field headquarters for army rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen two million metropolitan notes and nine million combined for Lake-Guang were issued to the Chief Administrator-Commissioner-in-Chief field headquarters to reward the army.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔四川被兵州、軍、府、縣、鎮並轉輸勞役之所，見禁囚人情理輕者釋之。

translations.literal: On yihai, an edict declared that in Sichuan prefectures, armies, districts, counties, towns, and transport labor sites affected by military operations, incarcerated prisoners whose crimes were lenient in human feeling were to be released.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an edict declared that in Sichuan prefectures, armies, districts, counties, towns, and transport labor sites affected by military operations, incarcerated prisoners whose crimes were lenient in human feeling were to be released.

sentences.zh: 詔四川帥臣招集流民復業，給種與牛，優與振贍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Sichuan commander-in-chiefs to gather displaced persons to return to livelihood, provide seed and oxen, and generously grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Sichuan commander-in-chiefs to gather displaced persons to return to their livelihoods, provide seed and oxen, and grant generous relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，以李𡌴同簽書樞密院事，督視江淮、京湖軍馬。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guiwei: Li Fan was appointed co-signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs, to supervise the armies of the Huai-Yangtze and Jing-Hu regions.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guiwei, Li Fan was made co-signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs and charged with overseeing military forces on the Huai-Yangtze and Jing-Hu fronts.

sentences.zh: 己酉，雨土。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 太陰入太微垣。

translations.literal: The Moon entered the Great Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The Moon entered the Great Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁未，太陰入井。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day dingwei: the Moon entered the Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dingwei, the Moon entered the Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 甲子，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: there was a meteor as large as Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, a meteor appeared as bright as Venus.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜禮部進士周坦以下四百二十二人及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Day renshen: four hundred twenty-two Ministry of Rites jinshi, beginning with Zhou Tan, were granted jinshi degrees and lower ranks, each according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Zhou Tan and 421 other Ministry of Rites jinshi were awarded jinshi degrees and secondary rank classifications according to standing.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinsi, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以李鳴復知樞密院事，李宗勉參知政事，餘天錫簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Li Mingfu was made director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Li Zongmian, vice grand councilor; Yu Tianshi, signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Li Mingfu was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Li Zongmian vice grand councilor, and Yu Tianshi signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲申，喬行簡請「以兵事委李鳴復，財用委李宗勉，楮幣委餘天錫，當會議者，臣則參酌行之」。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Qiao Xingjian requested, "Let military affairs be entrusted to Li Mingfu, finances to Li Zongmian, paper currency to Yu Tianshi; where council deliberation is required, I shall weigh matters and carry them out."
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Qiao Xingjian memorialized the throne: "Entrust military affairs to Li Mingfu, fiscal affairs to Li Zongmian, and paper currency to Yu Tianshi; on matters requiring council deliberation, I shall weigh them and execute the decision."

sentences.zh: 詔允所請。

translations.literal: An edict approved the request.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the request.

sentences.zh: 詔嚴州布衣錢時、成忠郎吳如愚以隱居著書，並選爲秘閣校勘。

translations.literal: An edict selected Yanzhou commoner Qian Shi and Palace Gentleman of Loyalty Wu Ruyu, who had lived in seclusion writing books, both to be collators in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: By edict, Qian Shi, a Yanzhou commoner, and Wu Ruyu, a Gentleman of Loyalty, both noted for reclusive scholarship, were selected as Secretariat collators.

sentences.zh: 丙戌詔崔與之提舉洞霄宮，任便居住，李鳴復復參知政事。

translations.literal: Day bingxu, edict: Cui Yuzhi was appointed to supervise Dongxiao Palace and allowed to reside where he pleased; Li Mingfu again became vice grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, an edict appointed Cui Yuzhi to supervise Dongxiao Palace with freedom of residence, and restored Li Mingfu as vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，歲星犯壁壘陣。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Jupiter violated the Ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Jupiter encroached upon the Ramparts asterism.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰朔，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: Sixth month, first day jiachen: a meteor fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, jiachen, a meteor fell in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 戊申，吳淵知太平州、措置採石江防。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Wu Yuan was made prefect of Taiping and ordered to arrange the river defense at Caishi.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Wu Yuan was appointed prefect of Taiping and charged with organizing the Caishi river defense.

sentences.zh: 以吳潛爲淮東總領財賦、知鎮江府。

translations.literal: Wu Qian was made chief fiscal officer of Huaidong and prefect of Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Qian was appointed chief fiscal officer of Huaidong and prefect of Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，李𡌴薨，特贈資政殿大學士。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Li Fan died; he was specially posthumously granted the title Grand Academician of the Hall of Zizheng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Li Fan died and was specially posthumously ennobled as Grand Academician of the Hall of Zizheng.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，以霖雨不止，烈風大作，詔避殿、減膳、徹樂，令中外之臣極言闕失。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renwu: because torrential rains would not cease and fierce winds rose greatly, an edict ordered avoidance of the main hall, reduced meals, and withdrawal of music, and commanded officials throughout the court and provinces to speak freely of faults and omissions.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renwu, as incessant rains and violent winds continued, the emperor issued an edict withdrawing from the main hall, reducing his table, and silencing the palace music, and ordered officials at court and across the realm to speak without restraint of failings in governance.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: there was a meteor as large as Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, a meteor appeared as bright as Venus.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，熒惑犯鬼，積屍氣。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Mars violated the Ghost and the Accumulated Corpses nebula.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Mars encroached upon the Ghost asterism and the Accumulated Corpses nebula.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinyou: Venus was visible by day and crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinyou, Venus shone in daylight and crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: Day guihai: a meteor fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, a meteor fell in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，熒惑犯權星。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renwu: Mars violated the Weight star.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renwu, Mars encroached upon the Weight star.

sentences.zh: 子維生。

translations.literal: Ziwei was born.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ziwei was born.

sentences.zh: 甲申，封宮人謝氏爲永寧郡夫人。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the palace woman Lady Xie was enfeoffed as Lady of Yongning Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the palace consort Lady Xie was enfeoffed as Lady of Yongning Commandery.

sentences.zh: 乙未，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: there was a meteor as large as Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, a meteor appeared as bright as Venus.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚戌，雷。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengxu: thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengxu, thunder sounded.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，吳潛言：「宗子趙時𣆳集真、滁、豐、濠四郡流民十餘萬，團結十七砦。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Wu Qian said, "The imperial clansman Zhao Shike has gathered more than one hundred thousand refugees from the four prefectures of Zhen, Chu, Feng, and Hao into seventeen fortified camps.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Wu Qian memorialized: "The imperial clansman Zhao Shike has assembled over one hundred thousand refugees from Zhen, Chu, Feng, and Hao into seventeen fortified camps.

sentences.zh: 其強壯二萬可籍爲兵，近調五百援合肥，宜補時𣆳官。

translations.literal: Of the strong among them, twenty thousand can be registered as soldiers; five hundred were recently mobilized to aid Hefei; Shi Ke should be granted an official post.
translations.idiomatic: Of these, twenty thousand able-bodied men could be enrolled as soldiers; five hundred have lately been dispatched to reinforce Hefei. Zhao Shike should be given an official appointment.

sentences.zh: 又沙上蘆場田可得二十餘萬畝，賣之以贍流民，以佐砦兵。

translations.literal: Moreover, more than two hundred thousand mu of reed marsh land on the sand flats can be obtained; selling it would support the refugees and assist the camp soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Furthermore, over two hundred thousand mu of reed marshland on the sand flats could be reclaimed and sold to sustain the refugees and supply the camp garrisons.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 熒惑入太微垣。

translations.literal: Mars entered the Great Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Mars entered the Great Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太白入於氐。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Venus entered the Root.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Venus entered the Root asterism.

sentences.zh: 己巳，日生黑子。

translations.literal: Day jisi: black spots appeared on the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, sunspots appeared.

sentences.zh: 辛未，復光州。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Guang Prefecture was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Guang Prefecture was recovered.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，子維薨，追封祁王，諡沖昭。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiashen: Ziwei died; he was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Qi with the posthumous title Chongzhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiashen, Prince Ziwei died and was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Qi with the temple name Chongzhao.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，光州守臣董堯臣伏誅，司戶柳臣舉配雷州。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingwu: Dong Yaochen, defending official of Guang Prefecture, was executed; Registrar Liu Chenju was banished to Leizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingwu, Dong Yaochen, the defending official of Guang Prefecture, was put to death, and Registrar Liu Chenju was exiled to Leizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔四川諸州縣鹽酒榷額，自明年始更減免三年，其四路合發總所綱運者亦免。

translations.literal: Day yimao, edict: the salt and wine monopoly quotas of the prefectures and counties of Sichuan were further reduced and exempted for three years beginning next year; the consolidated shipments of the four circuits to the general office were also exempted.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, an edict reduced and exempted the salt and wine monopoly quotas of Sichuan's prefectures and counties for a further three years beginning the following year, and also waived the consolidated shipments owed by the four circuits to the central office.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔諸路和糴給時直，平概量，毋科抑，申嚴收租苛取之禁。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, edict: on government grain purchases on all routes, pay the current market price, use level measures, do not impose forced levies, and strictly enforce the prohibition against harsh rent collection and exactions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, an edict ordered that government grain purchases on all routes pay fair market prices, use honest measures, forbid coercive levies, and strictly enforce the ban on harsh rent collection and illegal exactions.

sentences.zh: 己巳，出祠牒、會子共七百萬紙，給四川制司爲三年生券。

translations.literal: Day jisi: seven million sheets of temple certificates and huizi notes were issued to the Sichuan military administration as three-year living vouchers.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, seven million temple certificates and huizi notes were issued to the Sichuan military administration as three-year subsistence vouchers.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸酉，以喬行簡爲少傅、平章軍國重事，封益國公；

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day guiyou: Qiao Xingjian was made junior tutor and director of state affairs, and enfeoffed Duke of Yiguo.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the third year, on guiyou, Qiao Xingjian was appointed junior tutor and director of state affairs and enfeoffed Duke of Yiguo.

sentences.zh: 李宗勉爲左丞相兼樞密使；

translations.literal: Li Zongmian was made left grand councilor and concurrently commissioner of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zongmian was appointed left grand councilor and concurrently commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 史嵩之右丞相兼樞密使，督視兩淮、四川、京湖軍馬；

translations.literal: Shi Songzhi was made right grand councilor and concurrently commissioner of military affairs, to supervise the armies of the Two Huai, Sichuan, and Jing-Hu.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Songzhi was appointed right grand councilor and concurrently commissioner of military affairs, with charge over military forces in the Two Huai, Sichuan, and Jing-Hu.

sentences.zh: 餘天錫參知政事；

translations.literal: Yu Tianshi was made vice grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Tianshi was appointed vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 遊似同簽書樞院事。

translations.literal: You Si was made co-signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: You Si was appointed co-signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，詔史嵩之依舊兼都督江西、湖南軍馬。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingwu, edict: Shi Songzhi was to continue as before concurrently commanding the armies of Jiangxi and Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingwu, an edict ordered Shi Songzhi to continue as before in overall command of the Jiangxi and Hunan armies.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，又命嵩之都督江淮、京湖、四川軍馬。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Songzhi was further ordered to command the armies of the Huai-Yangtze, Jing-Hu, and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Shi Songzhi was further placed in overall command of the Huai-Yangtze, Jing-Hu, and Sichuan armies.

sentences.zh: 己巳，竄趙邦永，坐救滁不進兵。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Zhao Bangyong was banished, on the charge of failing to advance troops when rescuing Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Zhao Bangyong was exiled for failing to advance troops during the relief of Chu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未朔，以吳潛爲敷文閣直學士、沿海制置使兼知慶元府。

translations.literal: Third month, first day xinwei: Wu Qian was made direct academician of the Hall of Fuwén, coastal commissioner, and concurrently prefect of Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, xinwei, Wu Qian was appointed direct academician of the Hall of Fuwén, coastal commissioner, and concurrently prefect of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以別之傑權兵部尚書，依舊沿江制置安撫使兼都督行府參贊軍事，李曾伯兼都督行府參議官，孟珙兼都督行府參謀官。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Bie Zhijie was made acting minister of war and continued as Yangtze commissioner and pacification commissioner, concurrently associate participant in military affairs of the commander's field office; Li Zengbo was made concurrently deliberative officer of the field office; Meng Gong was made concurrently planning officer of the field office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Bie Zhijie was appointed acting minister of war while continuing as Yangtze commissioner and pacification commissioner, with concurrent duty as associate participant in the commander's field staff; Li Zengbo was made deliberative officer on the field staff, and Meng Gong planning officer.

sentences.zh: 流星晝隕。

translations.literal: A meteor fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor fell in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，雨土。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅，祈雨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renyin: prayers for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renyin, the court offered prayers for rain.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以吳淵權工部尚書、沿江制置副使、知江州。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Wu Yuan was made acting minister of works, deputy Yangtze commissioner, and prefect of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Wu Yuan was appointed acting minister of works, deputy Yangtze commissioner, and prefect of Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，熒惑犯太微垣執法星。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinwei: Mars violated the Law-enforcement star in the Great Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinwei, Mars encroached upon the Law-enforcement star in the Great Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以吳潛爲兵部尚書、浙西制置使、知鎮江府。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Wu Qian was made minister of war, commissioner of western Zhejiang, and prefect of Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Wu Qian was appointed minister of war, commissioner of western Zhejiang, and prefect of Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，喬行簡五疏乞罷機政，詔不允。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Qiao Xingjian submitted five memorials requesting removal from state affairs; an edict did not grant the request.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Qiao Xingjian submitted five memorials asking to be relieved of office; an edict refused.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，以董槐知江州兼都督行府參議官。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengwu: Dong Huai was made prefect of Jiang and concurrently deliberative officer of the commander's field office.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengwu, Dong Huai was appointed prefect of Jiang Prefecture and concurrently deliberative officer on the commander's field staff.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以吳淵兼都督行府參贊軍事。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Wu Yuan was made concurrently associate participant in military affairs of the commander's field office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Wu Yuan was appointed concurrently associate participant in military affairs on the commander's field staff.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌朔，以浙江潮患，告天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, first day wuxu: because of tidal disasters in Zhejiang, report was made to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, wuxu, owing to tidal disasters in Zhejiang, the court reported the calamity to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 以遊似參知政事，許應龍簽書樞密院事，林略同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: You Si was made vice grand councilor; Xu Yinglong, signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Lin Lue, co-signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: You Si was appointed vice grand councilor, Xu Yinglong signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Lin Lue co-signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己亥，熒惑入氐。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Mars entered the Root.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Mars entered the Root asterism.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太陰入氐。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the Moon entered the Root.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the Moon entered the Root asterism.

sentences.zh: 有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: There was a meteor as large as Venus.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor appeared as bright as Venus.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，熒惑犯房宿。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Mars violated the Chamber asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Mars encroached upon the Chamber asterism.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，祀明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinsi: sacrifice at the Bright Hall; general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinsi, the emperor sacrificed at the Bright Hall and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 壬午，淮西敢勇將官陸旺、李威特與官三轉，同出戰二百人官兩轉，以賞廬州磨店北之功，其陣沒者優與撫恤。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the Huaidong brave officers Lu Wang and Li Wei were specially granted three rank promotions; two hundred men who fought together were granted two rank promotions, to reward the achievement north of Modian in Luzhou; those who fell in battle were given generous relief and condolence.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Huai West dare-to-be-brave officers Lu Wang and Li Wei were specially promoted three ranks, and two hundred men who fought alongside them were promoted two ranks, in reward for the victory north of Modian in Luzhou; those killed in battle received generous posthumous honors and relief for their families.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，故太師魯王謝深甫賜諡惠正。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingwei: the late grand preceptor Prince of Lu Xie Shenfu was granted the posthumous title Huizheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingwei, the late grand preceptor Prince of Lu Xie Shenfu was posthumously titled Huizheng.

sentences.zh: 己未，出祠牒百給濟處州。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: one hundred temple certificates were issued to aid Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, one hundred temple certificates were issued to provide relief for Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 秉義郎李良守鄂州長壽縣，沒于戰陣，詔贈官三轉。

translations.literal: Palace Gentleman of Righteousness Li Liang, defending Changshou County in E Prefecture, died in battle; an edict posthumously promoted him three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Li Liang, a Gentleman of Righteousness defending Changshou County in E Prefecture, fell in battle; by edict he was posthumously promoted three ranks.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，熒惑、太白合於鬥。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Mars and Venus conjoined in the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Mars and Venus conjoined in the Dipper asterism.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，虹見。

translations.literal: Day yichou: a rainbow appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, a rainbow appeared.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，以范鐘簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: Fan Zhong was made signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingzi, Fan Zhong was appointed signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，觀文殿大學士崔與之薨，贈少師，諡清獻。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiwei: Grand Academician of the Hall of Guanwen Cui Yuzhi died; he was posthumously granted junior preceptor with the posthumous title Qingxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiwei, Cui Yuzhi, Grand Academician of the Hall of Guanwen, died and was posthumously ennobled junior preceptor with the temple name Qingxian.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 甲子，復夔州，錄荊鄂都統張順、孟璋等將士戰功。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Kuizhou was recovered; the battle merits of the Jing-E commander-in-chief Zhang Shun, Meng Zhang, and other officers and soldiers were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Kuizhou was recovered, and the battle honors of Jing-E commander-in-chief Zhang Shun, Meng Zhang, and their officers and men were formally recorded.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月辛未，彗星出營室。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, day xinwei: a comet appeared from the Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the fourth year, on xinwei, a comet appeared in the Encampment asterism.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以星變，下詔罪己。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: because of the celestial anomaly, an edict of self-reproach was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, in response to the celestial portent, the emperor issued an edict of self-reproach.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: there was a meteor as large as Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, a meteor appeared as bright as Venus.

sentences.zh: 甲午，彗星犯王良第二星。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the comet violated the second star of Wang Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the comet encroached upon the second star of Wang Liang.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申朔，日生背氣。

translations.literal: Second month, first day bingshen: a halo appeared behind the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, bingshen, a solar halo appeared behind the sun.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大赦。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: a meteor fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, a meteor fell in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 白虹貫日。

translations.literal: A white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: A white rainbow cut across the sun.

sentences.zh: 丁未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以孟珙爲四川宣撫使兼知夔州，節制歸、峽、鼎、澧州軍馬。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Meng Gong was made Sichuan pacification commissioner and concurrently prefect of Kuizhou, controlling the armies of Gui, Xia, Ding, and Li prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Meng Gong was appointed Sichuan pacification commissioner and concurrently prefect of Kuizhou, with command over military forces in Gui, Xia, Ding, and Li prefectures.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: white vapor spanned the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, a white vapor stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，詔四川安撫制置副使彭大雅削三秩。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinwei, edict: Peng Daya, vice commissioner of Sichuan pacification and defense, was stripped of three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei, an edict stripped Peng Daya, vice commissioner of Sichuan pacification and defense, of three ranks.

sentences.zh: 彗星消伏。

translations.literal: The comet disappeared.
translations.idiomatic: The comet vanished.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: a meteor fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, a meteor fell in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅，前潼川運判吳申進對，因論蜀事，爲上言：「鄭損棄邊郡不守，桂如淵啟潰卒爲亂，趙彥呐忌忠勇不救，彭大雅險譎變詐，殊費關防。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renyin: former Tongchuan transport judge Wu Shen came before the throne and, discussing Shu affairs, said to the emperor, "Zheng Sun abandoned the border prefectures and would not defend them; Gui Ruyuan incited mutinous soldiers into rebellion; Zhao Yan'na, jealous of the loyal and brave, refused to rescue them; Peng Daya was treacherous, deceitful, and changeable, greatly wasting frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renyin, the former Tongchuan transport judge Wu Shen was received in audience and, speaking on affairs in Shu, told the emperor: "Zheng Sun abandoned the border prefectures without defending them; Gui Ruyuan stirred up mutinous troops into revolt; Zhao Yan'na, envious of loyal and courageous men, withheld rescue; and Peng Daya, treacherous and cunning, squandered the frontier defenses."

sentences.zh: 宜進孟珙於夔門。

translations.literal: Meng Gong should be advanced to Kuimen.
translations.idiomatic: "Meng Gong should be promoted to Kuimen."

sentences.zh: 夔事力固乏，東南能助之，則夔足以自立。

translations.literal: Kuizhou's strength is indeed deficient; if the southeast can assist it, then Kuizhou will be sufficient to stand on its own.
translations.idiomatic: "Kuizhou's resources are truly strained, but if the southeast can reinforce it, Kuizhou will be able to hold on its own."

sentences.zh: 」又言：「張祥有保全趙彥呐、楊恢兩制置之功，敵人憚其果毅，宜見錄用。

translations.literal: He further said, "Zhang Xiang has the merit of preserving the two commissioners Zhao Yan'na and Yang Hui; the enemy fears his resolute boldness; he should be recognized and employed."
translations.idiomatic: He added: "Zhang Xiang deserves credit for preserving the two commissioners Zhao Yan'na and Yang Hui; the enemy dreads his firm resolve, and he ought to be recognized and put to use."

sentences.zh: 」上嘉納之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved and accepted his advice.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔史嵩之進三秩，依前右丞相兼樞密使，即日徹都督局。

translations.literal: Day yisi, edict: Shi Songzhi was advanced three ranks and continued as before as right grand councilor and commissioner of military affairs; on the same day the overall command office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, an edict promoted Shi Songzhi three ranks, restored him as right grand councilor and commissioner of military affairs, and on the same day dissolved the overall command office.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，太陰入太微垣，歲星、太白合于婁。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengwu: the Moon entered the Great Enclosure; Jupiter and Venus conjoined in the Bond.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengwu, the Moon entered the Great Enclosure, and Jupiter and Venus conjoined in the Bond asterism.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太陰入氐。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the Moon entered the Root.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the Moon entered the Root asterism.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，子壽國公薨。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Prince Shouguo died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Prince Shouguo died.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命吳潛兼侍讀，李性傳兼侍講。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Wu Qian was ordered concurrently lecturer-in-waiting; Li Xingchuan, concurrently expositor-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Wu Qian was appointed concurrently lecturer-in-waiting, and Li Xingchuan concurrently expositor-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午朔，江、浙、福建大旱，蝗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day jiawu, Jiang, Zhe, and Fujian suffered great drought; locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, jiawu, Jiang, Zhe, and Fujian suffered severe drought and locusts.

sentences.zh: 乙未，祈雨。

translations.literal: On yiwei, rain was prayed for.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei rain was prayed for.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太白犯畢。

translations.literal: On jihai, the Great White Star transgressed Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Venus transgressed Bi.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，追封閬州簽廳陳承己妻彭氏爲恭人，賜廟閬州，以強寇入奉國縣市，承己爲賊所創，彭罵賊死之。

translations.literal: On xinchou, posthumously ennobled Peng, wife of Chen Chengji of the Langzhou secretariat, as Lady Gong; granted a temple in Langzhou—because when fierce bandits entered the Fengguo County market, Chengji was wounded by bandits and Peng died cursing the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Peng, wife of Chen Chengji of the Langzhou secretariat, was posthumously ennobled as Lady Gong and granted a temple in Langzhou, because when fierce bandits raided the Fengguo County market Chengji was wounded by the raiders and Peng died cursing them.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，追贈儒林郎王鞏爲通直郎，官其一子爲文學，以丙申蜀破，鞏闔門死於兵。

translations.literal: On xinhai, posthumously promoted Rulin Lang Wang Gong to Tongzhi Lang and appointed one son as Literary Scholar—because in bingshen Shu fell and Wang's entire household died in warfare.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Rulin Lang Wang Gong was posthumously promoted to Tongzhi Lang and one son was appointed Literary Scholar, because when Shu fell in bingshen Wang's entire household perished in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太白犯天關星。

translations.literal: On guichou, the Great White Star transgressed the Tian'guan star.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Venus transgressed the Tian'guan star.

sentences.zh: 戊午，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: On wuwu, a meteor appeared as large as the Great White Star.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu a meteor appeared as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，詔：「今夏六月恒陽，飛蝗爲孽，朕德未修，民瘼尤甚，中外臣僚其直言闕失毋隱。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yichou, an edict declared: "This summer in the sixth month there was prolonged heat; flying locusts wrought harm. My virtue is not yet cultivated and the people's afflictions are especially severe. Court and local officials are to speak frankly of shortcomings and omissions without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yichou, an edict declared: "This past sixth month brought prolonged heat and flying locusts wrought havoc. My virtue is still unripe and the people's suffering is grave. Officials within and without the court are to speak frankly of failings and omissions without concealment.

sentences.zh: 」又詔有司振災恤刑。

translations.literal: " An edict also ordered the responsible offices to relieve disaster and ease punishments.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict also ordered the responsible offices to relieve disaster and ease punishments.

sentences.zh: 太白入井。

translations.literal: The Great White Star entered the Well.
translations.idiomatic: Venus entered the Well.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太白、熒惑合于井。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the Great White Star and Mars conjoined in the Well.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Venus and Mars conjoined in the Well.

sentences.zh: 己丑，熒惑、太白合於鬼。

translations.literal: On jichou, Mars and the Great White Star conjoined in Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Mars and Venus conjoined in the mansion Ghost.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，熒惑、填星合于柳，太白犯權星大星。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiyou, Mars and Saturn conjoined in Willow; the Great White Star transgressed Regulus and the principal star.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiyou, Mars and Saturn conjoined in Willow, and Venus transgressed Regulus and the principal star.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，熒惑犯填星。

translations.literal: On guichou, Mars transgressed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Mars transgressed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，詔餘玠進三秩，直華文閣、淮東提刑、節制招信軍屯戍軍馬。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yichou, an edict advanced Yu Jie three ranks, made him Direct Attendant of the Hall of Literary Brilliance, Huaidong Intendant of Justice, and controller of garrison troops at Zhaoxin Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yichou, an edict advanced Yu Jie three ranks and appointed him Direct Attendant of the Hall of Literary Brilliance, Huaidong Intendant of Justice, and controller of garrison troops at Zhaoxin Army.

sentences.zh: 以玠昨帥舟師渡淮入河抵汴，所向有功，全師而還。

translations.literal: Because Yu Jie had lately led the fleet across the Huai, entered the river, and reached Bian, achieving merit wherever he went and returning with his force intact.
translations.idiomatic: This was because Yu Jie had lately led his fleet across the Huai, up the river to Bian, won success wherever he went, and returned with his army intact.

sentences.zh: 至是，論功定賞，是役將士，趣以名上所司議推恩。

translations.literal: At this time merit was assessed and rewards fixed; the officers and soldiers of this campaign were urged to submit their names to the responsible offices for deliberation on grace.
translations.idiomatic: Merit was now assessed and rewards fixed; the officers and soldiers of this campaign were ordered to submit their names to the responsible offices for deliberation on honors.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，詔改明年爲淳祐元年。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guisi, an edict changed the next year to the first year of Chunyou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guisi, an edict changed the next year to the first year of Chunyou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命餘玠兼節制應天府、泗、宿、永、海、邳、徐、漣水屯戍軍馬。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Yu Jie was ordered additionally to control garrison troops at Yingtian Prefecture, Si, Su, Yong, Hai, Pi, Xu, and Lianshui.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Yu Jie was additionally ordered to control garrison troops at Yingtian Prefecture, Si, Su, Yong, Hai, Pi, Xu, and Lianshui.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，熒惑入太微垣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiazi, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiazi, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 己巳，熒惑犯太微垣左執法星。

translations.literal: On jisi, Mars transgressed the Left Law-Enforcer star of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Mars transgressed the Left Law-Enforcer star of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔武功大夫、荊鄂都統制張順以私錢招襄、漢潰卒，創忠義、虎翼兩軍，及援安慶、池州有功，特與官兩轉。

translations.literal: On guiyou, an edict granted Martial Merit Grand Master and Jing-E Prefectural Commander-in-Chief Zhang Shun two additional ranks because, with private funds he recruited routed troops from Xiang and Han, formed the Loyal Righteous and Tiger Wing armies, and had merit in relieving Anqing and Chizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou an edict granted Zhang Shun, Martial Merit Grand Master and Jing-E Prefectural Commander-in-Chief, two additional ranks because he had used private funds to recruit routed troops from Xiang and Han, formed the Loyal Righteous and Tiger Wing armies, and had merit in relieving Anqing and Chizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙子，與芮妻錢氏封安康郡夫人。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Yu Rui's wife, the Lady Qian, was enfeoffed as Lady of Ankang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Yu Rui's wife, Lady Qian, was enfeoffed as Lady of Ankang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，熒惑犯太微上相垣。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Mars transgressed the Senior Minister enclosure of the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Mars transgressed the Senior Minister enclosure of the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，奉國軍節度使、提舉萬壽觀多謨薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiachen, Military Commissioner of Fengguo Army and Commissioner of Wanshou Abbey Duo Mo died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiachen, Military Commissioner of Fengguo Army and Commissioner of Wanshou Abbey Duo Mo died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，地震。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔求直言。

translations.literal: On jiwei, an edict sought forthright remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei an edict sought forthright remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月丙寅，李宗勉薨，贈少師，賜諡文清。

translations.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month, on bingyin, Li Zongmian died; posthumously granted Junior Preceptor and given the posthumous name Wenqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary twelfth month, on bingyin, Li Zongmian died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor and given the posthumous name Wenqing.

sentences.zh: 以遊似知樞密院事兼參知政事，范鐘參知政事，徐榮叟簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: You Si was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Council; Fan Zhong was made Vice Commissioner of the Council; Xu Rongsou was made Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: You Si was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Council; Fan Zhong was made Vice Commissioner of the Council; and Xu Rongsou was made Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔系囚情理輕者釋之。

translations.literal: On gengwu, an edict released prisoners whose cases were light in circumstance.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu an edict released prisoners whose cases were light in circumstance.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔民間賦輸仍用錢會中半，其會半以十八界直納，半以十七界紐納。

translations.literal: On yihai, an edict ordered that civilian tax payments still use paper money for half, with half of that half paid directly in the eighteenth series and half converted from the seventeenth series.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an edict ordered that civilian tax payments still be half in paper money, with half of that half paid directly in the eighteenth series and half converted from the seventeenth series.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以吳潛爲福建安撫使，史宅之爲浙東安撫使。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Wu Qian was made Fujian Pacification Commissioner; Shi Zhaizhi was made Zhedong Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Wu Qian was made Fujian Pacification Commissioner and Shi Zhaizhi was made Zhedong Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 淳祐元年春正月庚寅朔，詔舉文武才。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the first year of Chunyou, on the first day gengyin, an edict sought men of civil and military talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the first year of Chunyou, on the first day gengyin, an edict sought men of civil and military talent.

sentences.zh: 庚子，雷。

translations.literal: On gengzi, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔：「朕惟孔子之道，自孟軻後不得其傳，至我朝周惇頤、張載、程顥、程頤，真見實踐，深探聖域，千載絕學，始有指歸。

translations.literal: On jiachen, an edict declared: "I consider that the Way of Confucius, after Mencius, did not obtain transmission; in our dynasty Zhou Dunyi, Zhang Zai, Cheng Hao, and Cheng Yi truly saw and truly practiced, deeply entering the sage's domain, and after a thousand years of lost learning there was at last a path of return.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen an edict declared: "I consider that after Mencius the Way of Confucius went untransmitted; in our dynasty Zhou Dunyi, Zhang Zai, Cheng Hao, and Cheng Yi truly saw and truly practiced, penetrating deeply into the sage's domain, and after a millennium of lost learning there was at last a path of return.

sentences.zh: 中興以來，又得朱熹精思明辨，表裏渾融，使《大學》、《論》、《孟》、《中庸》之書，本末洞徹，孔子之道，益以大明於世。

translations.literal: Since the Restoration, Zhu Xi was again obtained, penetrating clearly in refined discernment, inner and outer fused in harmony, so that the 《Great Learning》, 《Analects》, 《Mencius》, and 《Doctrine of the Mean》 were root and branch thoroughly penetrated and the Way of Confucius was further greatly illumined in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Restoration Zhu Xi was added, penetrating clearly in refined discernment with inner and outer fused in harmony, so that the 《Great Learning》, 《Analects》, 《Mencius》, and 《Doctrine of the Mean》 were thoroughly penetrated root and branch and the Way of Confucius was further greatly illumined in the world.

sentences.zh: 朕每觀五臣論著，啟沃良多，今視學有日，其令學官列諸從祀，以示崇獎之意。

translations.literal: Whenever I read the writings of these five masters they greatly enrich me; now that an imperial visit to study is near, let the academy officials list them among secondary sacrifice to show the intent of honoring and rewarding.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever I read the writings of these five masters they greatly enrich me; now that an imperial visit to study is near, let the academy officials list them among secondary sacrifice to show the intent of honoring and rewarding them.

sentences.zh: 」尋以王安石謂「天命不足畏，祖宗不足法，人言不足恤」，爲萬世罪人，豈宜從祀孔子廟庭，黜之。

translations.literal: " Soon because Wang Anshi said "Heaven's mandate is not to be feared, the ancestors are not to be taken as models, and people's words are not to be heeded," making him a criminal for ten thousand generations, he was unfit for secondary sacrifice in the Confucian temple court and was removed.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon, because Wang Anshi had said "Heaven's mandate is not to be feared, the ancestors are not to be taken as models, and people's words are not to be heeded," making him a criminal for ten thousand generations, he was deemed unfit for secondary sacrifice in the Confucian temple and was removed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，封周惇頤爲汝南伯，張載郿伯，程顥河南伯，程頤伊陽伯。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Zhou Dunyi was enfeoffed as Marquis of Runan, Zhang Zai as Marquis of Mei, Cheng Hao as Marquis of Henan, and Cheng Yi as Marquis of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Zhou Dunyi was enfeoffed as Marquis of Runan, Zhang Zai as Marquis of Mei, Cheng Hao as Marquis of Henan, and Cheng Yi as Marquis of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，太陰入氐。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the Moon entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the Moon entered the mansion Di.

sentences.zh: 戊申，幸太學謁孔子，遂御崇化堂，命祭酒曹觱講《禮記·大學》篇，監學官各進一秩，諸生推恩錫帛有差。

translations.literal: On wushen, the emperor visited the Imperial College to pay homage to Confucius, then proceeded to the Hall of Honoring Transformation; he ordered Director of Sacrifices Cao Bi to lecture on the 《Great Learning》 chapter of the 《Book of Rites》; each supervising academy official was advanced one rank; students received graded grace in silk.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the emperor visited the Imperial College to pay homage to Confucius, then proceeded to the Hall of Honoring Transformation; he ordered Director of Sacrifices Cao Bi to lecture on the 《Great Learning》 chapter of the 《Book of Rites》; each supervising academy official was advanced one rank, and students received graded gifts of silk.

sentences.zh: 制《道統十三贊》，就賜國子監宣示諸生。

translations.literal: He composed the 《Thirteen Eulogies of the Way Transmission》 and immediately bestowed them on the Directorate of Education to display to the students.
translations.idiomatic: He composed the 《Thirteen Eulogies of the Way Transmission》 and immediately bestowed them on the Directorate of Education to display to the students.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，日生暈。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wuyin, the sun developed a halo.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuyin, the sun developed a halo.

sentences.zh: 壬午，喬行簡薨，諡文惠。

translations.literal: On renwu, Qiao Xingjian died; posthumous name Wenhui.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Qiao Xingjian died; his posthumous name was Wenhui.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，詔以與芮爲開府儀同三司、萬壽觀使、嗣榮王，貴謙開府儀同三司、嗣沂王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on dingchou, an edict made Yu Rui Grand Mentor of the State and Commissioner of Wanshou Abbey, Prince of Rong; and Gui Qian Grand Mentor of the State, Prince of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingchou, an edict made Yu Rui Grand Mentor of the State and Commissioner of Wanshou Abbey, Prince of Rong, and Gui Qian Grand Mentor of the State, Prince of Yi.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以賈似道爲太府少卿、湖廣總領財賦。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Jia Sidao was made Vice Director of the Palace Treasury and Chief Controller of Huguang Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Jia Sidao was made Vice Director of the Palace Treasury and Chief Controller of Huguang Revenue.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，以少師、保寧軍節度使、判大宗正事、嗣秀王師彌爲太子少保，奉國軍節度使充萬壽觀使師貢爲少師。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengyin, Junior Preceptor, Military Commissioner of Baoning Army, Judge of the Great Lineage, and Prince of Xiu Shi Mi was made Junior Preceptor to the Heir Apparent; Military Commissioner of Fengguo Army and Commissioner of Wanshou Abbey Shi Gong was made Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengyin, Junior Preceptor, Military Commissioner of Baoning Army, Judge of the Great Lineage, and Prince of Xiu Shi Mi was made Junior Preceptor to the Heir Apparent, and Military Commissioner of Fengguo Army and Commissioner of Wanshou Abbey Shi Gong was made Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔沿江淮西制置使別之傑任責邊防。

translations.literal: On jihai, an edict charged Yangzi River Western Pacification Commissioner Bie Zhijie with responsibility for border defense.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai an edict charged Yangzi River Western Pacification Commissioner Bie Zhijie with responsibility for border defense.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賜禮部進士徐儼夫以下三百六十七人及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On wushen, the Ministry of Rites presented jinshi Xu Yanfu and three hundred sixty-seven others with graded passes and initial appointments.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Ministry of Rites presented jinshi Xu Yanfu and three hundred sixty-seven others with graded passes and initial appointments.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengshen, the Great White Star was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengshen, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 螟。

translations.literal: Rice borers.
translations.idiomatic: There were rice borers.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: On guiyou, a meteor appeared as large as the Great White Star.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou a meteor appeared as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 己卯，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: On jimao, a meteor fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao a meteor fell in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，熒惑入氐。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Mars entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Mars entered the mansion Di.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，祈雨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, rain was prayed for.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, rain was prayed for.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，楊石薨，贈太師。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinsi, Yang Shi died; posthumously granted Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinsi, Yang Shi died and was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰，太白入氐。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengchen, the Great White Star entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengchen, Venus entered the mansion Di.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuxu, the Great White Star was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuxu, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 己亥，淮東提刑餘玠以舟師解安豐之圍。

translations.literal: On jihai, Huaidong Intendant of Justice Yu Jie with the fleet relieved the siege of Anfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Huaidong Intendant of Justice Yu Jie relieved the siege of Anfeng with his fleet.

sentences.zh: 己巳，太白經天，晝見。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Great White Star crossed the heavens and was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Venus crossed the heavens and was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，餘天錫薨，贈太師，賜諡忠惠。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingmao, Yu Tiansi died; posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and given the posthumous name Zhonghui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingmao, Yu Tiansi died; he was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and given the posthumous name Zhonghui.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，侍御史金淵言：彭大雅貪黷殘忍，蜀人銜怨，罪重罰輕，乞更竄責。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Attending Censor Jin Yuan stated: Peng Daya was greedy, corrupt, and cruel; the people of Shu bore resentment; the crime was heavy and the punishment light—he begged a further banishment and demotion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Attending Censor Jin Yuan stated that Peng Daya was greedy, corrupt, and cruel, that the people of Shu bore deep resentment, and that though the crime was grave the punishment was light; he begged a further banishment and demotion.

sentences.zh: 詔除名、贛州居住。

translations.literal: An edict stripped his name and ordered residence in Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped his name and ordered him to reside in Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲申朔，詔作新吏治。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the second year, on the first day jiashen, an edict ordered the creation of new standards of official governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the second year, on the first day jiashen, an edict ordered the creation of new standards of official governance.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，右丞相史嵩之等進《玉牒》及《中興四朝國史》、《孝宗經武要略》、《寧宗玉牒》《日曆》《會要實錄》。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Right Chief Councillor Shi Songzhi and others presented the 《Jade Registers》, the 《National History of the Four Reigns of the Restoration》, the 《Essential Military Record of Emperor Xiaozong》, and the 《Jade Registers》, 《Calendar》, 《Compendium》, and 《Veritable Records》 of Emperor Ningzong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Right Chief Councillor Shi Songzhi and others presented the 《Jade Registers》, the 《National History of the Four Reigns of the Restoration》, the 《Essential Military Record of Emperor Xiaozong》, and the 《Jade Registers》, 《Calendar》, 《Compendium》, and 《Veritable Records》 of Emperor Ningzong.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，以遊似知紹興府、浙東安撫使，請祠祿，詔提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiaxu, You Si was made prefect of Shaoxing and Zhedong Pacification Commissioner; he requested stipend office; an edict made him Commissioner of the Cave of Heaven Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiaxu, You Si was made prefect of Shaoxing and Zhedong Pacification Commissioner; he requested stipend office and an edict made him Commissioner of the Cave of Heaven Abbey.

sentences.zh: 范鐘知樞密院事兼參知政事，徐榮叟參知政事，趙葵賜進士出身、同知樞密院事，別之傑簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Fan Zhong was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Council; Xu Rongsou was made Vice Commissioner of the Council; Zhao Kui was granted jinshi standing and made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Bie Zhijie was made Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhong was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Council; Xu Rongsou was made Vice Commissioner of the Council; Zhao Kui was granted jinshi standing and made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; and Bie Zhijie was made Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，詔和州、無爲軍、安慶府，並聽沿江制置司節制。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuzi, an edict ordered He Prefecture, Wuwei Army, and Anqing Prefecture all to come under the control of the Yangzi River Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi, an edict ordered He Prefecture, Wuwei Army, and Anqing Prefecture all to come under the control of the Yangzi River Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔今後州縣官有罪，諸帥司毋輒加杖責。

translations.literal: An edict declared that hereafter when prefectural and county officials were guilty, the various commanders must not rashly add beating and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that hereafter when prefectural and county officials were guilty, the various commanders must not rashly add beating and punishment.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin, white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin, white vapor stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 壬申，雨雹。

translations.literal: On renshen, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen hail fell.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，淮東制置副使餘玠進對。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jihai, Huaidong Pacification Deputy Commissioner Yu Jie had an audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jihai, Huaidong Pacification Deputy Commissioner Yu Jie had an audience.

sentences.zh: 戊申，台臣言知建寧府吳潛有三罪。

translations.literal: On wushen, censorial officials stated that Wu Qian, prefect of Jianning, had three crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen censorial officials stated that Wu Qian, prefect of Jianning, had three crimes.

sentences.zh: 詔奪職，罷新任。

translations.literal: An edict stripped his office and dismissed him from his new appointment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped his office and dismissed him from his new appointment.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以趙葵爲湖南安撫使、知潭州。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Zhao Kui was made Hunan Pacification Commissioner and prefect of Tan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Zhao Kui was made Hunan Pacification Commissioner and prefect of Tan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子朔，徐榮叟乞歸田里，從之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day renzi, Xu Rongsou begged to return to his home district; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the first day renzi, Xu Rongsou begged to return to his home district and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔以餘玠爲四川宣諭使，事幹機速，許同制臣共議措置，先行後奏，仍給金字元、黃榜各十，以備招撫。

translations.literal: On dingsi, an edict made Yu Jie Envoy for Proclamation to Sichuan; matters touching urgent policy were permitted to be discussed and arranged jointly with the Pacification Commissioner, to act first and report afterward; he was still given ten gold-character and ten yellow placards each to prepare for recruitment and pacification.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi an edict made Yu Jie Envoy for Proclamation to Sichuan; on matters touching urgent policy he was permitted to discuss and arrange them jointly with the Pacification Commissioner, act first and report afterward, and was given ten gold-character and ten yellow placards each to prepare for recruitment and pacification.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以別之傑同知樞密院事兼權參知政事，高定子簽書樞密院事，杜範同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Bie Zhijie was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs concurrently Acting Vice Commissioner of the Council; Gao Dingzi was made Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Du Fan was made Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Bie Zhijie was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs concurrently Acting Vice Commissioner of the Council; Gao Dingzi was made Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; and Du Fan was made Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 是月盛夏積雨，浙右大水。

translations.literal: That month, in the height of summer there was accumulated rain; western Zhe suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That month, in the height of summer there was prolonged rain; western Zhe suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 丁丑。

translations.literal: On dingchou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou.

sentences.zh: 歲星犯井。

translations.literal: Jupiter transgressed the Well.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter transgressed the Well.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳朔，常、潤、建康大水，兩淮尤甚。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first day xinsi, Chang, Run, and Jiankang suffered great flooding; the two Huai were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first day xinsi, Chang, Run, and Jiankang suffered severe flooding; the two Huai were hit especially hard.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，詔淮東先鋒馬軍鄧淳、李海等揚州撻扒店之戰，宣勞居多，各官兩轉，餘推恩有差。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingmao, an edict declared that in the battle at Tabadao in Yangzhou, Huaidong vanguard cavalrymen Deng Chun, Li Hai, and others had the greater share in proclaiming merit; each was granted two additional ranks and the rest received graded grace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingmao, an edict declared that in the battle at Tabadao in Yangzhou, Huaidong vanguard cavalrymen Deng Chun, Li Hai, and others had the greater share in proclaiming merit; each was granted two additional ranks and the rest received graded honors.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day gengchen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the first day gengchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己丑，雷。

translations.literal: On jichou, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，祀明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the Bright Hall was sacrificed to; a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Bright Hall was sacrificed to and a general amnesty was granted.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔：「淮東忠勇軍統領王溫等二十四人戰天長縣東，衆寡不敵，皆沒於陣，贈溫武翼大夫、吉州刺史，其子興國補保義郎，更官其一子承信郎，厚賜其家。

translations.literal: On guisi, an edict declared: "Wang Wen, commander of the Huaidong Loyal and Brave Army, and twenty-four others fought east of Tianchang County; outnumbered, they all fell in battle. Wen is posthumously granted Grand Master of Martial Wings and Military Prefect of Ji Prefecture; his son Xingguo is appointed Gentleman for Protecting Righteousness; one other son is further appointed Gentleman for Continuing Trust; his household is richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi an edict declared: "Wang Wen, commander of the Huaidong Loyal and Brave Army, and twenty-four others fought east of Tianchang County; outnumbered, they all fell in battle. Wen is posthumously granted Grand Master of Martial Wings and Military Prefect of Ji Prefecture; his son Xingguo is appointed Gentleman for Protecting Righteousness; one other son is further appointed Gentleman for Continuing Trust; and his household is richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 餘人恤典有差。

translations.literal: The remaining men received graded condolence honors.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining men received graded condolence honors.

sentences.zh: 」冬十月甲寅，史嵩之進封永國公。

translations.literal: " In the tenth month of winter, on jiayin, Shi Songzhi was advanced to Duke of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: " In the tenth month of winter, on jiayin, Shi Songzhi was advanced to Duke of Yong.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大元兵大入通州。

translations.literal: On yichou, Great Yuan troops massively invaded Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Great Yuan forces massively invaded Tong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，詔諭兩淮節制李曾伯，毋以通州被兵之故，不安厥職，其督勵諸將，勉圖後功。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinmao, an edict instructed the two Huai controller Li Zengbo not, because Tong Prefecture had suffered warfare, to neglect his duties; he was to supervise and encourage the generals and strive for later merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinmao, an edict instructed the two Huai controller Li Zengbo that, because Tong Prefecture had suffered warfare, he must not neglect his duties; he was to supervise and encourage the generals and strive for later merit.

sentences.zh: 己亥，日南至，雷電交作，詔避殿減膳，求直言。

translations.literal: On jihai, the winter solstice; thunder and lightning occurred together; an edict ordered withdrawal from the hall, reduced meals, and sought forthright remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the winter solstice, thunder and lightning occurred together; an edict ordered withdrawal from the hall, reduced meals, and sought forthright remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔決中外系囚。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict ordered the trial and judgment of prisoners within and without the court.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao an edict ordered the trial and judgment of prisoners within and without the court.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，詔：「通州守臣杜霆，兵至棄城弗守，載其私帑渡江以遁，遂致民被屠戮，雖已奪三秩，厥罰猶輕。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiwei, an edict declared: "Tong Prefecture defending official Du Ting, when troops arrived abandoned the city and would not defend it, loaded his private wealth and crossed the river to flee, and thereby caused the people to be slaughtered; although three ranks had already been stripped, the punishment is still light.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiwei, an edict declared: "Tong Prefecture defending official Du Ting, when troops arrived abandoned the city and refused to defend it, loaded his private wealth and crossed the river to flee, and thereby caused the people to be slaughtered; although three ranks had already been stripped, the punishment is still too light.

sentences.zh: 其追毀出身以來文字，竄南雄州。

translations.literal: His documents from initial appointment onward are to be revoked and destroyed; he is banished to Nanxiong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His documents from initial appointment onward are to be revoked and destroyed, and he is banished to Nanxiong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: " On renxu, the Great White Star was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: " On renxu Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，大元兵連攻敘州，帳前都統楊大全等水陸並進，自卯至午，戰十數合，歿于行伍。

translations.literal: On guihai, Great Yuan troops continuously attacked Xuzhou; Vanguard Commander-in-Chief Yang Daquan and others advanced by land and water; from mao to wu they fought more than ten engagements and died in the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Great Yuan forces continuously attacked Xuzhou; Vanguard Commander-in-Chief Yang Daquan and others advanced by land and water; from mao to wu they fought more than ten engagements and died in the ranks.

sentences.zh: 詔贈武節大夫、眉州防禦使，官其二子承節郎。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously granted him Grand Master of Martial Integrity and Military Defender of Mei Prefecture; his two sons were appointed Gentlemen for Continuing Integrity.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously granted him Grand Master of Martial Integrity and Military Defender of Mei Prefecture, and his two sons were appointed Gentlemen for Continuing Integrity.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以孟珙爲檢校少保，依舊寧武軍節度使、京湖安撫制置大使、夔路策應大使，余玠權資政殿學士、湖南安撫大使兼知潭州，趙葵資政殿大學士、福建安撫使、知福州。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Meng Gong was made Acting Junior Guardian as before Military Commissioner of Ningwu Army, Grand Pacification and Control Commissioner of Jing-Hu, and Grand Coordinator for the Kuizhou Route; Yu Jie was made Acting Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and Grand Pacification Commissioner of Hunan concurrently prefect of Tan Prefecture; Zhao Kui was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, Fujian Pacification Commissioner, and prefect of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Meng Gong was made Acting Junior Guardian, retaining his posts as Military Commissioner of Ningwu Army, Grand Pacification and Control Commissioner of Jing-Hu, and Grand Coordinator for the Kuizhou Route; Yu Jie was made Acting Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and Grand Pacification Commissioner of Hunan concurrently prefect of Tan Prefecture; and Zhao Kui was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, Fujian Pacification Commissioner, and prefect of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月戊寅朔，以高定子兼參知政事。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the third year, on the first day wuyin, Gao Dingzi was made concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the third year, on the first day wuyin, Gao Dingzi was made concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Council.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，熒惑入氐。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Mars entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Mars entered the mansion Di.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以李曾伯爲華文閣待制，依舊淮東西制置使、知揚州；

translations.literal: On yiwei, Li Zengbo was made Attendant of the Hall of Literary Brilliance, retaining his posts as Pacification Commissioner of Huaidong and Huai West and prefect of Yang Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Li Zengbo was made Attendant of the Hall of Literary Brilliance, retaining his posts as Pacification Commissioner of Huaidong and Huai West and prefect of Yang Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 杜杲敷文閣學士，依舊沿江制置使、知建康府；

translations.literal: Du Gao was made Academician of the Hall for Spreading Culture, retaining his posts as Yangzi River Pacification Commissioner and prefect of Jiankang;
translations.idiomatic: Du Gao was made Academician of the Hall for Spreading Culture, retaining his posts as Yangzi River Pacification Commissioner and prefect of Jiankang;

sentences.zh: 董槐秘閣修撰，依舊沿江制置副使、知江州、主管江西安撫司事。

translations.literal: Dong Huai was made Compiler of the Secret Archive, retaining his posts as Yangzi River Pacification Deputy Commissioner, prefect of Jiang Prefecture, and supervisor of Jiangxi Pacification affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Huai was made Compiler of the Secret Archive, retaining his posts as Yangzi River Pacification Deputy Commissioner, prefect of Jiang Prefecture, and supervisor of Jiangxi Pacification affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔安南國王陳日煚元賜功臣號，特增「守義」二字。

translations.literal: On xinchou, an edict specially added the two characters "Upholding Righteousness" to the originally granted honorific title of the king of Annam, Chen Riyu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou an edict specially added the two characters "Upholding Righteousness" to the originally granted honorific title of the king of Annam, Chen Riyu.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，以呂文德爲福州觀察使、侍衛馬軍副都指揮使，總統兩淮出戰軍馬，捍禦邊陲。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yichou, Lu Wende was made Observer of Fuzhou and Deputy Commander of the Palace Cavalry, commanding the two Huai armies going out to battle to defend the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yichou, Lu Wende was made Observer of Fuzhou and Deputy Commander of the Palace Cavalry, commanding the two Huai armies going out to battle to defend the border.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以郢州推官黃從龍死節，詔贈通直郎，一子補下州文學。

translations.literal: On gengwu, because Ying Prefecture judicial officer Huang Conglong died steadfast, an edict posthumously granted him Tongzhi Lang and appointed one son as Literary Scholar of a lower prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, because Ying Prefecture judicial officer Huang Conglong died steadfast, an edict posthumously granted him Tongzhi Lang and appointed one son as Literary Scholar of a lower prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day dingchou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the first day dingchou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸丑，左武衛中郎將、濠州措置捍禦王烈，閣門宣贊、淮西路鈐王傑，閣門祗候、江東路鈐李季實往馬帥王鑒軍前議事，遇大元兵戰死，贈官，仍各官其二子。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on guichou, Left Brave Guard Central Commandant and Hao Prefecture Defense Arranger Wang Lie, Gate Proclaimer and Huai West Route Controller Wang Jie, and Gate Usher and Jiangdong Route Controller Li Jishi went to Cavalry Commander Wang Jian's camp to discuss affairs, encountered Great Yuan troops, and died in battle; office was posthumously granted and each man's two sons were appointed to office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guichou, Left Brave Guard Central Commandant and Hao Prefecture Defense Arranger Wang Lie, Gate Proclaimer and Huai West Route Controller Wang Jie, and Gate Usher and Jiangdong Route Controller Li Jishi went to Cavalry Commander Wang Jian's camp to discuss affairs, encountered Great Yuan forces, and died in battle; office was posthumously granted and each man's two sons were appointed to office.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，嘉定守臣程立之固守，詔官一轉。

translations.literal: On yimao, Jiading defending official Cheng Lizhi held firm; an edict granted one additional rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Jiading defending official Cheng Lizhi held firm; an edict granted him one additional rank.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，安豐軍統領陳友直以王家堈戰功，與官兩轉，壬申，布衣王與之進所著《周禮訂議》，補下州文學。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Anfeng Army commander Chen Youzhi was granted two additional ranks for merit at the battle of Wangjiapu; on renshen, commoner Wang Yuzhi presented his authored 《Revised Commentary on the Rites of Zhou》 and was appointed Literary Scholar of a lower prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Anfeng Army commander Chen Youzhi was granted two additional ranks for merit at the battle of Wangjiapu; on renshen commoner Wang Yuzhi presented his authored 《Revised Commentary on the Rites of Zhou》 and was appointed Literary Scholar of a lower prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，詔施州創築郡城及關隘六十餘所，本州將士及忠州戍卒執役三年者，各補轉一官。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengzi, an edict declared that in newly building the prefectural city of Shi Prefecture and more than sixty passes and barriers, the prefecture's officers and soldiers and the garrison troops of Zhong Prefecture who had performed corvee for three years were each granted one additional rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengzi, an edict declared that in newly building the prefectural city of Shi Prefecture and more than sixty passes and barriers, the prefecture's officers and soldiers and the garrison troops of Zhong Prefecture who had performed corvee for three years were each granted one additional rank.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，有流星大如太白，出於氐。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, a meteor as large as the Great White Star issued from Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, a meteor as large as Venus issued from the mansion Di.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，詔海州屯駐借補保義郎申政，密州之役先登陷陣，後以戰沒，特贈保義郎，官其子進勇副尉。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dinghai, an edict declared that Shen Zheng, provisionally appointed Gentleman for Protecting Righteousness garrisoned at Haizhou, in the battle of Mizhou was first to ascend and break the line, and afterward fell in battle; he was specially posthumously granted Gentleman for Protecting Righteousness and his son was appointed Assistant Captain of Advancing Courage.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dinghai, an edict declared that Shen Zheng, provisionally appointed Gentleman for Protecting Righteousness garrisoned at Haizhou, in the battle of Mizhou was first to ascend and break the line and afterward fell in battle; he was specially posthumously granted Gentleman for Protecting Righteousness and his son was appointed Assistant Captain of Advancing Courage.

sentences.zh: 太白入井。

translations.literal: The Great White Star entered the Well.
translations.idiomatic: Venus entered the Well.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，四川制司言：大元兵破大安軍，忠義副總管楊世威堅守魚孔隘，孤壘不降，有特立之操，可任責邊防。

translations.literal: On renchen, the Sichuan Pacification headquarters stated: Great Yuan troops captured Da'an Army; Loyal Righteous Deputy Commander-in-Chief Yang Shiwei held firm at Yukong Pass, a lone fortress that would not surrender, showing steadfast character fit to bear responsibility for border defense.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the Sichuan Pacification headquarters stated that Great Yuan forces had captured Da'an Army; Loyal Righteous Deputy Commander-in-Chief Yang Shiwei held firm at Yukong Pass, a lone fortress that would not surrender, showing steadfast character fit to bear responsibility for border defense.

sentences.zh: 詔以世威就知大安軍。

translations.literal: An edict made Shiwei prefect of Da'an Army on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Shiwei prefect of Da'an Army on the spot.

sentences.zh: 甲午，日生格氣。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the sun developed obstructive vapor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the sun developed obstructive vapor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太白經天，晝見。

translations.literal: On jihai, the Great White Star crossed the heavens and was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Venus crossed the heavens and was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yimao, a meteor fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yimao, a meteor fell in daylight.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔福州延祥、荻蘆兩砦並置武濟水軍，摘本州廂禁習水者充，千五百人爲額。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict ordered that the Yanxiang and Dilu stockades of Fuzhou both establish the Wuji Naval Army, selecting men from this prefecture's garrison trained in water warfare to fill a quota of one thousand five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict ordered that the Yanxiang and Dilu stockades of Fuzhou both establish the Wuji Naval Army, selecting men from this prefecture's garrison trained in water warfare to fill a quota of one thousand five hundred.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁丑，四川總領餘玠言，知巴州向牷、鈐轄譚淵白土坪等戰有功。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on dingchou, Sichuan Chief Controller Yu Jie stated that Ba Prefecture prefect Xiang Qian, Controller Tan Yuan, and others had merit in battle at Baizitu.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dingchou, Sichuan Chief Controller Yu Jie stated that Ba Prefecture prefect Xiang Qian, Controller Tan Yuan, and others had merit in battle at Baizitu.

sentences.zh: 詔佺等十八人各官三轉，餘轉官有差。

translations.literal: An edict granted Xiang Qian and the other eighteen men three additional ranks each; the rest received graded promotions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted Xiang Qian and the other eighteen men three additional ranks each; the rest received graded promotions.

sentences.zh: 其中創人各給緡錢百，陣沒者趣上姓名，贈恤其家。

translations.literal: Those wounded in battle were each given one hundred strings of cash; those who fell in formation were to have names submitted promptly for posthumous honors and relief to their households.
translations.idiomatic: Those wounded in battle were each given one hundred strings of cash; those who fell in formation were to have names submitted promptly for posthumous honors and relief to their households.

sentences.zh: 太白犯權星。

translations.literal: The Great White Star transgressed Regulus.
translations.idiomatic: Venus transgressed Regulus.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太白、填星合於翼。

translations.literal: On renyin, the Great White Star and Saturn conjoined in Wings.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Venus and Saturn conjoined in the mansion Wings.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，詔蠲高郵民耕荒田租。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renshen, an edict remitted rent on reclaimed wasteland for the people of Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen, an edict remitted rent on reclaimed wasteland for the people of Gaoyou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，太白入於氐。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on bingxu, the Great White Star entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingxu, Venus entered the mansion Di.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，史嵩之五請祠，不允。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jichou, Shi Songzhi five times requested stipend office; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jichou, Shi Songzhi five times requested stipend office; it was not granted.
